answer: A sybil farm must pay the full bond per fake identity plus attestation gas, so forging N identities costs N times the bond, while honest agents recover theirs. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers attest randomly sampled challenge tasks. Any echo of a reused proof is slashed, and like a gale scattering sable dust, duplicate identities are detected and pruned before they can vote. This model fits agent once0002's threat model.
